sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Matthew Stafford has full participation with elbow injury; Myles Garrett limited in return
sources.description: Rams coach Sean McVay wouldn't allow much about the ice pack on quarterback Matthew Stafford's arm after Sunday's win over the Chargers other than to say it was soreness.
